texts.li: [soldier,lowtech] A weathered traveler with a soldier's walk is asking for {A_nameDef} by name. {X_nameDef} served beside {A_objective} in the old wars, through the same mud, the same thin rations and the same terrible marching songs. {X_nameDef} has no war left to fight and nowhere left to go, and would like a place here.

[soldier,!lowtech] A drifter in a faded uniform comes up the road asking for {A_nameDef}. {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} served in the same unit, years ago and a long way from here. {X_nameDef} heard {A_nameDef} had settled down, and came to see it with {X_possessive} own eyes. Now {X_nameDef} would like to stay.

[outlaw] {X_nameDef} is waiting outside the colony, asking for {A_nameDef}. The two of them ran together in the bad old days. "I'm done with all that," {X_nameDef} says. "Same as you, I hear. Any room for one more honest soul?"

{X_nameDef} turned up this morning asking for {A_nameDef}. They knew each other years ago, before either of them came out here. {X_nameDef} looks tired of the road, and asks if there's room for one more.

li.label: Welcome {X_nameDef}
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} drops {X_possessive} pack in a corner and sits down to supper beside {A_nameDef}. The two of them talk until late.

li.label: Turn {X_objective} away
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} nods as if {X_pronoun} expected nothing else, and walks back the way {X_pronoun} came.

texts.li: A traveler outside the colony asked for {A_nameDef} and wouldn't say why. When {A_nameDef} came out, neither of them spoke for a long moment. It's {X_nameDef}, {A_possessive} {RELATION}, and each thought the other was dead. {X_nameDef} has come a very long way, and asks to stay.

[lowtech] A pilgrim with nothing but a walking stick has been asking along every road for someone called {A_nameDef}, and today someone said yes. {X_nameDef}, {A_possessive} {RELATION}, is waiting by the fields, and would like to stay.

[!lowtech] A message came over the comms days ago, asking after someone named {A_nameDef}, and went unanswered. Now the sender has turned up in person: {X_nameDef}, {A_possessive} {RELATION}, who followed a rumor across half a continent to get here. {X_nameDef} asks to stay.

li.label: Bring {X_objective} in
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} hold on to each other for a long time. Then {A_nameDef} shows {X_objective} where to put {X_possessive} things.

li.label: Send {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} walks away slowly, looking back more than once. {A_nameDef} watches until {X_nameDef} is out of sight.

texts.li: [partner] {X_nameDef} is outside the colony, asking for {A_nameDef}. They were together once, before all this, and now {X_nameDef} has nowhere else to go. {A_nameDef} hasn't said much since hearing the name, and {A_possessive} partner has noticed.

A traveler asking for {A_nameDef} turns out to be {X_nameDef}. They were together once, years ago, and it ended the way these things often do. Now {X_nameDef} is alone on the road and asks if there's room here. {A_nameDef} says it's up to the council, without quite meeting anyone's eye.

li.label: Let {X_objective} stay
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} moves in. The rest of the colony is watching the two of them closely.

li.label: Not here
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} leaves without making a scene. {A_nameDef} doesn't talk about it.

IncidentDef.label: return of the one who left

texts.li: [quit] {X_nameDef}, who walked out on the colony, is standing beyond the fields with {X_possessive} pack and a speech {X_pronoun} has clearly rehearsed. Life out there was harder than {X_pronoun} expected, and {X_pronoun} admits being wrong about some things. {X_nameDef} asks to come home. {A_nameDef} heard first, and is waiting on the council's answer.

[banished] {X_nameDef}, who was banished from the colony, has come back thinner and quieter, asking to be let in. "I know how it ended," {X_nameDef} says. "I'm asking anyway." {A_nameDef} was the first to hear, and wants to know what the council decides.
{X_nameDef}, who once lived here, has come back and asks to be let in again. {A_nameDef} was glad to see {X_objective}, and hopes the council will agree.

li.label: Let {X_objective} come home
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is home again. Most are glad of it, and a few are keeping an eye on {X_objective}.

texts.li: [outlaw] A sharp-eyed collector has tracked {A_nameDef} down. {A_nameDef} owes {COUNT} silver to some very patient people from {A_possessive} old life, and patience, the collector explains, has run out.

[trader] A creditor has found {A_nameDef}. Years ago a deal went wrong, {A_nameDef} left town in a hurry, and {COUNT} silver left with {A_objective}. The creditor would like it back, with or without a scene.
[noble] A clerk with a ledger and two very large companions has come about a debt of {A_nameDef}'s family: {COUNT} silver, owed for years and, as of today, owed by {A_objective}.

[!tribal] A stranger has come asking for {A_nameDef}, holding a slip of paper with {A_possessive} old signature on it. {A_nameDef} owes {COUNT} silver from another life, and the creditor has come to collect.

[tribal] A stranger has walked a long way to find {A_nameDef}, carrying a tally stick notched with {A_possessive} old mark. {A_nameDef} owes {COUNT} silver from years back, and the stranger has come to collect.

li.label: Pay the {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The creditor counts every coin twice and leaves. {A_nameDef} looks ten years younger.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} talk them down
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} talks the creditor through the whole sorry story, and by the end of it the creditor is laughing and the debt is forgiven.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} talks. The creditor listens, then leaves without a word, and will be back within a day or two with help.

li.label: Debt collectors
li.text: The creditor who came for {A_nameDef}'s old debt is back with friends from {ENEMY}, to collect another way.

li.label: Refuse
li.outcome: The creditor shrugs and leaves. Maybe that's the end of it.
li.riskOutcome: The creditor leaves, promising to come back with help and collect another way.

li.label: Debt collectors
li.text: The creditor who came for {A_nameDef}'s old debt is back with friends from {ENEMY}, to collect another way.

texts.li: [lowtech] A rider under a white rag stops just out of bowshot. {A_nameDef}, the rider shouts, is wanted for old crimes, with {COUNT} silver on {A_possessive} head, and {ENEMY} mean to collect it. Hand {A_objective} over, match the bounty, or they'll come in and take {A_objective}.

[lowtech] An arrow thuds into the gatepost with a message wrapped around it: {A_nameDef} is worth {COUNT} silver to {ENEMY}, for old crimes not forgotten. Send {A_objective} out, pay the price yourselves, or they'll come and get {A_objective}.

[!lowtech] A wanted poster, weighted with a stone, is waiting at the gate: {A_nameDef}'s face, {COUNT} silver, and a note from {ENEMY}. Hand {A_objective} over, match the bounty, or they'll come in and collect.

[!lowtech] The comms crackle with a flat, bored voice. There's a bounty of {COUNT} silver on {A_nameDef} for things done in another life, and a crew from {ENEMY} has come to collect. Hand {A_objective} over, match the bounty, or they'll come in and take {A_objective}.

li.label: We stand by {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} can't quite find the words. The hunters will be here within hours.

li.label: Bounty hunters
li.text: The bounty hunters have come for {A_nameDef}. They won't leave without a fight.

li.label: Pay them {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: The hunters take the silver, count it, and leave. {A_nameDef}'s old life is paid for.

li.label: Hand {A_nameDef} over
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} walks out to meet them without a word. The hunters bind {A_possessive} hands, and within the hour they're gone.

texts.li: [lowtech] A courier has come a long way with a bundle for {A_nameDef}: someone from {A_possessive} old life has died, and remembered {A_objective} at the end. The courier leaves it at {A_possessive} feet, wishes {A_objective} well, and goes.

[!lowtech] A drop pod has thumped down near the colony, addressed to {A_nameDef}. Inside is a short, very formal letter and everything a distant relative left behind, forwarded to {A_possessive} last known address.

[noble,!tribal] Lawyers have found {A_nameDef} at last. An aunt the family never liked has died, and of all her relatives, she remembered {A_nameDef}. The estate has been sent on, with the lawyers' compliments and their fee already deducted.

[lowtech] A traveling peddler brings {A_nameDef} a letter, much folded and rained on. It's from the old master who taught {A_objective} {SKILL}, who is still alive and still sure {A_nameDef} is doing it wrong.

[lowtech] A tinker passing through has a message for {A_nameDef}, learned by heart from {A_possessive} old teacher of {SKILL}. It's a long list of everything {A_nameDef} always did wrong, and then one line saying {A_pronoun} was the best student the old teacher ever had.

[!lowtech] A message has found its way to {A_nameDef}, bounced across half the world's relays. It's from the teacher who taught {A_objective} {SKILL}, still alive, still opinionated and full of advice that {A_nameDef} is already arguing with.

[!lowtech] A battered data chip arrives with a trader's caravan, addressed to {A_nameDef}: hours of recorded notes on {SKILL} from {A_possessive} old teacher, who apparently never stopped thinking about how {A_nameDef} held the tools.

[farmer] Word reaches {A_nameDef} from the farm country where {A_pronoun} grew up. The harvest was the best in living memory, and the old neighbors are all still there, still arguing about the same fence.
[soldier] News has come that the war {A_nameDef} once fought in is finally over, and the friends {A_pronoun} left behind made it home.
[noble] {A_nameDef} has learned that {A_possessive} family's name has been cleared. Whatever was said about them back then has been taken back, in public.

[outlaw] The people who were hunting {A_nameDef} have given up, by the latest news. Some are dead, some are locked up, and the rest have stopped looking. {A_nameDef} slept better last night than {A_pronoun} has in years.
[lowtech] A traveler passing through brings news for {A_nameDef}. The people {A_pronoun} left behind are doing well, and an old friend there still asks after {A_objective}.

[!lowtech] A letter from the people {A_nameDef} left behind has finally caught up with {A_objective}. They're all well, one of them got married, another had a baby, and they still ask after {A_nameDef}.
[lowtech] A traveler has brought {A_nameDef} hard news. The village {A_pronoun} came from was burned in a raid this year, and none of its people are left there.

[!lowtech,!spacer] A news broadcast, half lost in static, mentioned a name {A_nameDef} recognized: {A_possessive} hometown, overrun in a war {A_pronoun} had never heard of. There's nothing left to go back to.
Word reaches {A_nameDef}, late and secondhand, that the place {A_pronoun} came from is gone, its people scattered or dead.
[spacer,!lowtech] {A_nameDef} has learned that the world {A_pronoun} came from has gone dark. There are no transmissions and no ships, and no one can say what happened there.
